description: Search pets to adopt in the places we list (Taiwan, King County WA, Montgomery County MD, Zaragoza, and Vienna, found pets only: marked found:true, not adoptable yet; found=exclude leaves them out). Nowhere else yet. Search near a place (nearest first), by species, age, size, sex, breed and color, or by words in any of 10 languages (q). No place and no country = everything we list. Returns names, short facts, distance, the rescue and a link to each listing, plus what q was understood as; an empty answer says what we do list.

age.description: Taiwan says only Young or Adult

breed.description: Breed name in any language, or Wikidata id

country.description: TW, US (King County WA, Montgomery County MD only), ES (Zaragoza) or AT (Vienna, found pets only). Not needed with near

detail.description: find_pets default brief; full = every field of pet.v1

facets.description: Add counts by species, size, age, sex, region

found.description: Found pets (Vienna's, announced for their owners first) are included by default, marked found:true, NOT adoptable. exclude = adoptable only. Never call one adoptable

good_with.description: Only pets whose listing says so; rarely stated. kids is not offered; if it is passed anyway, the answer lists pets whose listing does not say (good_with_soft, each not_stated). For such wishes prefer search_by_description

lang.description: The person's language: en, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, ja, vi, fr, ar, tl (default en)

min_photo_px.description: Best photo's longest side, at least, in pixels

near.description: A US ZIP (98101), lat,lon, a Taiwan county or township in any language (信義區, 臺北市), Zaragoza or Wien; never a street address. Nearest first; an uncovered place gets the nearest pets we hold, marked not nearby

photo.description: good: only pets whose best photo passed our checks; unanalysed pets are left out (only Taiwan's are analysed)

place.description: near as structured fields; never a street address

area.description: A Taiwan county or township, Zaragoza or Wien

latitude.description: Only with longitude, if the person shared it

q.description: Words in the person's language: breeds, colors, ages, sizes, sex and places become filters, the rest is full-text ("黑色柴犬")

region.description: Taiwan county or city, e.g. Taipei City

size.description: Not stated in King County or Vienna

name: find_pets
title: Find pets to adopt
